{{Top|canon=Rodian Trad Co}}
'''Rodian Trading Co.''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] company. A [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] employed by this company accompanied Rodian hunting expeditions to the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] where he bought all kinds of junk from the Rodian hunters and other individuals.
